title: Balance Between Having Foreign Talent and Local Workforce Development in Financial Sector
what_it_is: Balance Between Having Foreign Talent and Local Workforce Development in Financial Sector

sections.label: Financial sector local workforce investment
sections.summary: Singapore invests in local financial sector skills, attracting talent, with over 80% local workforce and MAS committing $400 million for training from 2021 to 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Working closely with industry, we invest heavily in building skills and capabilities in our local workforce to enable our locals to take up good jobs in our financial sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: As a leading regional and global financial centre, Singapore must continue to attract high-quality talent, both locally and from abroad, in order to stay competitive.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: We are now a leading financial centre in Asia and the third most competitive globally.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: We are home to over 2,500 licensed financial institutions and employ close to over 200,000 people.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Over 80% of our financial sector workforce is local and the sector offers the highest median gross incomes amongst employed locals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Over 2018 to 2023, the financial sector workforce grew by more than 25,000, of which more than nine out of 10 of the net jobs created went to locals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: To help locals acquire skills and capabilities to take on the good jobs in our financial sector, MAS has committed $400 million from 2021 to 2025 to support the training of local finance professionals at each stage of their careers.

sections.label: OCBC Ignite polytechnic students
sections.summary: OCBC Ignite aims to benefit 500 polytechnic students and graduates over three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: OCBC Ignite aims to benefit 500 polytechnic students and graduates over three years.

sections.label: COMPASS local employment points
sections.summary: MOM's COMPASS applications award points based on locals' share of PMET roles to encourage firms to support local employment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower's (MOM’s) Complementarity Assessment Framework (COMPASS) applications encourage firms to support local employment by awarding points based on locals’ share of professional, manager, executive and technician (PMET) roles in the firm.
